plugin.name: BuddyPress Group Moderation
plugin.scope: single site; BuddyPress with the Groups component. Inert with an admin notice on BuddyBoss, without BuddyPress or with Groups off (bp_group_moderation_requirements_met(), checked on bp_include); never deactivates itself.
plugin.licensed: free: no licence key and no bundled updater; updates are GitHub releases

params: reason (reject only, sanitize_textarea_field, max 500 chars, optional)
ajax.responses: 400 bad request, 403 no capability/nonce, 500 save failed; success with 'already approved or rejected' when the group is no longer pending; success data includes pending (int) and pendingText for the menu badge and list total

admin_pages.title: Pending Groups
admin_pages.note: 20 per page (paged GET), name search (s) and newest/oldest sort (order=desc|asc), pending count bubble on the menu item updated after each AJAX decision

admin_pages.title: WB Plugins
admin_pages.note: only registered when no other Wbcom plugin created it first

settings.save_path: options.php; sanitize callback merges the toggles over the stored option

subkeys.bp_group_moderation_auto_approve_admin: bool, default true (applied by bp_group_moderation_fetch_settings via wp_parse_args, no activation write)
subkeys.bp_group_moderation_send_emails: bool, default true (applied by bp_group_moderation_fetch_settings via wp_parse_args, no activation write)
subkeys.bp_group_moderation_delete_data_on_unins: bool, default false; read by uninstall.php

group_meta.approval_status: 'pending' while a group waits; deleted on approve
group_meta.requested_status: visibility the creator asked for, applied on approve

user_meta: bp_grp_moderation_rejected_group_{group_id}: group name, written on every reject (read by the group_rejected notification formatter via secondary_item_id = creator)

notifications.mark_read: BP_Group_Moderation_Notifications::bp_group_moderation_mark_read_from_request() on template_redirect and load-<Pending Groups hook>: nonce, bp_notifications_check_notification_access(), then BP_Notifications_Notification::update() scoped to id + user_id; by-type marking limited to the plugin's three actions
notifications.cleanup: BuddyPress core deletes group notifications on groups_delete_group; approve deletes every admin's new_group_pending for the group; deactivation renames only these three actions to bp_mod_groups, activation restores them

assets.css: assets/css/bp-group-moderation-admin.css (+ .min, css-rtl twin built by grunt rtlcss)

uninstall: uninstall.php: clears the cron event; always deletes the legacy 1.0.0 licence options and transient (edd_wbcom_group_moderation_license_key, _license_status, _license_key_data); deletes the settings option only when bp_group_moderation_delete_data_on_uninstall is on

generated.from: manual delta, 2nd team audit of branch 1.0.1

legacy_cron: bp_group_moderation_hourly_check (1.0.0): unscheduled on load when present and on deactivation; the pending state is enforced by groups_group_before_save instead

hooks_consumed.name: groups_create_group
hooks_consumed.use: hold every new group (create screen, REST, CLI, other plugins): requested_status, approval_status=pending, hidden; notify admins unless on the create screen

hooks_consumed.name: groups_group_create_complete
hooks_consumed.use: create screen finished: notify admins of the pending group (once)

hooks_consumed.name: groups_group_before_save
hooks_consumed.use: keep a pending group hidden; store a changed status as requested_status

hooks_consumed.name: bp_get_new_group_status
hooks_consumed.use: preselect the requested privacy on Manage > Settings (Nouveau)

hooks_consumed.name: bp_after_accept_invitation_parse_args
hooks_consumed.use: refuse invitation accept for pending groups (profile, AJAX, REST)

hooks_consumed.name: bp_after_has_groups_parse_args
hooks_consumed.use: hide invites to pending groups from the invitee list

hooks_consumed.name: bp_after_has_activities_parse_args
hooks_consumed.use: exclude created_group/avatar/cover activity of pending groups (one query, cached)

hooks_consumed.name: bp_after_groups_invite_user_parse_args
hooks_consumed.use: invite to a pending group is created as a draft (send_invite=0)

hooks_consumed.name: bp_after_groups_send_invitation_parse_args
hooks_consumed.use: groups_send_invites() for a pending group sends nothing; approval sends the drafts

cache.flushed: on pending set, approve, reject, group delete

approve_side_effects: hide_sitewide cleared on created_group/avatar/cover activity when approved public; held draft invitations sent (BP notification + email)
settings_screen: registered unconditionally (main file); with requirements unmet it renders the requirements notice and hides the Pending Groups button
